Plan your waterless retrofit

Begin with the building you have.

01Assess02Plan03Document
01

Survey the existing washroom

Record each fixture location, mounting arrangement and drainage connection. Note recurring blockages, odours or slow flow before considering replacement. An existing drainage problem belongs in the project scope.

02

Define the work

Ask the installer to separate removal, plumbing changes, wall repairs, mounting and commissioning. Confirm access times, waste removal and who makes good the surrounding finishes.

03

Prepare the handover

Before reopening, obtain current model instructions, a list of compatible consumables and a named maintenance owner. Keep the installer’s scope and service contact with the site records.
